properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued November 19 at 8:45AM PST until November 19 at 9:45AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
SVRLOX

The National Weather Service in Los Angeles/Oxnard has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central and Southern Los Angeles County in southwestern
California...

* Until 945 AM PST.

* At 845 AM PST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
6 miles north of La Canada Flintridge to 9 miles southwest of
Rancho Palos Verdes, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts. Small chance for a brief, weak tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Downtown Los Angeles, Long Beach, Hollywood, Burbank, Santa Monica.
properties.instruction:
Stay indoors and away from windows.

Tornadoes can develop quickly from severe thunderstorms. Seek shelter
immediately in an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built
structure.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued November 19 at 9:37AM PST until November 19 at 9:45AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts. Small chance for a brief, weak tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
